content: Relation between ContainerIPdu and contained IPdu s on receiver side On receiver side, it is not necessarily required to stat- ically define which IPdu s may be contained inside a ContainerIPdu if the header mode is used. Thus it would be possible to update the senders of Con- tainerIPdu s and put different or additional IPdu s inside.
